messages:
alisa: Need to schedule the inference perf + cost benchmark review. Who's available next week?
raj: count me in. prefer Tue/Wed morning PT.
maria: Wed morning PT works. Can we make the agenda focused: latency dashboards, cost regression, quantization impact, and rollout risks?
simon: +1. also want a short deep-dive on kernel selection for long-sequence tails (10-20m).
jess: Wed morning is a conflict for me, but I can join the second half or watch recording. Is 45m enough?
alisa: thinking 60m since we need readouts + Q/A + action items. propose Wed 10:00–11:00 PT.
raj: that works for me. I'll reserve a room.
maria: can we ask infra to snapshot the dedicated cluster metrics for the last 72h before the meeting?
infra-bot: scheduled snapshot job. Artifact ID: infra-snap-1715029001. Will attach graphs to the thread when ready.
benchmark-bot: latest bench run completed: run-id=bench-1715028807. Summary: p50=18ms, p95=72ms (seq=1024), cost/token delta +3% vs last week. Artifact: s3://redwood-bench/bench-1715028807/results.json
simon: can someone paste the quick command to reproduce the latency curves?
maria: sure — use the bench harness with the same workload profile:
```
bench run --suite=latency_tail --model=opt-30b-qt --seq=1024 --concurrency=8 --out=bench-1715028807
```
raj: I'll add that to the calendar invite with the agenda. Action item: everyone post 1 slide of key metric or short note in the thread by Tue EOD.
jess: I'll do a slide on client-side batching effects and a quick note on streaming overhead.
alisa: Maria — can you include the cost breakdown per model variant (quant vs fp16) in the pre-reads?
maria: yes, sending a short table by Tue noon.
benchmark-bot: posted artifact link: https://s3.redwood.internal/bench/bench-1715028807/summary.html
raj: Invite sent (Wed 10–11 PT). Calendar includes Zoom, agenda, and links to infra snapshot + bench summary. Please RSVP.
simon: RSVP'd. Also suggest we allocate 10m to decide rollback/fallback thresholds if p95 > 100ms.
alisa: good point. I'll add 'rollback thresholds' to agenda.
jess: RSVP maybe (will join 10:30). If I can't make 10:30 I'll ping notes/questions here.
maria: pre-read uploaded: drive.redwood.com/drive/u/0/folders/bench-pre-reads (permissions: eng-ml view).
raj: cool. final ask: anyone who needs special charts (token distribution by request class etc.) shout now and infra will add.
simon: can infra add per-route p95 and cache hit-rate for the last 24h?
infra-bot: added per-route p95 and prefix-cache hit-rate graphs to infra-snap-1715029001.
alisa: perfect. Thanks everyone — see you Wed. :+1:
